answer: An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The vertex schedule is applied in yarrow and signal shows each instalment. A payout is split so that 36% arrives at settlement and the rest over 16 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4217 identities would post 632 proofs and burn roughly 20 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
